name: dent-experts-scoper-wrapper
description: Capacitor wrapper scaffold for the Dent Experts Scoper PWA.

scripts.cap:sync: npm run prepare:capacitor && npx cap sync
scripts.cap:sync:with-config: npm run prepare:capacitor:with-config && npx cap sync
scripts.cap:copy: npm run prepare:capacitor && npx cap copy
scripts.cap:add:ios: npm run prepare:capacitor && npx cap add ios
scripts.ios:build:sim: npm run cap:sync && xcodebuild -workspace ios/App/App.xcworkspace -scheme App -configuration Debug -destination 'generic/platform=iOS Simulator' build
scripts.ios:clean:build:sim: npm run cap:sync && xcodebuild -workspace ios/App/App.xcworkspace -scheme App -configuration Debug -destination 'generic/platform=iOS Simulator' clean build
scripts.ios:sync:clean:build: npm run cap:sync && npm run ios:clean:build:sim
scripts.ios:build:device: npm run cap:sync && xcodebuild -workspace ios/App/App.xcworkspace -scheme App -configuration Debug -destination "id=${IOS_DEVICE_ID}" -allowProvisioningUpdates -allowProvisioningDeviceRegistration build
scripts.ios:install:device: APP_PATH=$(ls -td ~/Library/Developer/Xcode/DerivedData/App-*/Build/Products/Debug-iphoneos/App.app | head -n1) && xcrun devicectl device install app --device "${IOS_DEVICE_ID}" "$APP_PATH"
scripts.ios:launch:device: xcrun devicectl device process launch --device "${IOS_DEVICE_ID}" com.v8zqk8u83a.dentexpertsscoper
scripts.ios:testflight:install: echo 'Using global fastlane installed via brew'
